title: Reset TextDecoder when decode() throws
body:
When decode() threw while streaming, the next invocation continued with the decoder, I/O queue, and BOM seen as they were when the error occurred. As the output up to the error is not returned, continuing from there is not useful, and implementations disagreed on what remained. Instead the next invocation now starts anew.

TextDecoderStream is unaffected, as an error there errors the stream.

Also remove the "Otherwise" steps that follow early returns in decode(), which removes a level of nesting.

Fixes #358 and fixes #359.
